established: The issuer descriptor leading zero is an initial file offset; adopter signed-aligns descriptor+0 and stores slot+2C.
Slot+28 byte count is independent. Existing error-helper count==-1 policy is consumed, not a new experiment.
Normalized output changes exactly descriptor.flags to initial_file_offset and the one matching established sentence; no record/state flag or prior branch result is changed.
limitations: Natural failed IO producer/state, byte-count writers between adoption and error helper, ownership/recovery/cancellation and lifetime
Input read size initially passed by original issuer does not prove its later error-helper count; offset0 has no error opt-in meaning
Producer validity is not independent review or canonical incorporation. Natural reachability/IO/scheduling/lifetime not certified.
